name: Pumpkin-Chocolate Chip Cupcakes with Cream Cheese Frosting

instructions.primary_message: Cut cream cheese and butter into small pieces. Transfer to the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment; set aside to soften while you prepare the cake.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (227 g) block cream cheese
2 tbsp butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F.  Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners and set aside.
Place flour, baking powder, baking soda, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1 tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
1 tsp pumpkin pie spice
½ tsp ginger, ground
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs, pumpkin, oil, both sugars, and vanilla in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the wet ingredients.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (425 g) can pure pumpkin purée
½ cup neutral vegetable oil
½ cup brown sugar
¼ cup granulated sugar
1 ½ tsp vanilla extract

instructions.primary_message: Add dry ingredients to the bowl with the wet ingredients and whisk until just combined.
Add chocolate chips to the batter and stir to incorporate (take care not to over-mix the batter).

Fill the cupcake liners three-quarters full with batter (about ¼-cup each). Place muffin pan in the oven and bake until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cupcake comes out clean, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool to room temperature, about 1 hour.

While the cupcakes are baking, prepare the frosting. Beat the softened cream cheese and butter on medium speed until smooth and creamy, stopping to scrape down the sides of the bowl with a silicone spatula as needed, about 2 minutes.
Add vanilla to the bowl and continue to beat on medium until just combined. Scrape down the bowl.

Using a strainer, sift powdered sugar into the bowl. Beat on medium once more, until smooth and creamy, about 1 minute. Scrape down the bowl. Set frosting aside at room temperature until you are ready to decorate the cupcakes.

When the cupcakes are cool, divide the vanilla cream cheese frosting between them; use a butter knife to spread the frosting over the top of each cupcake in an even layer. Top each with a few additional chocolate chips.
Once decorated, transfer cupcakes to a platter and enjoy! If planning ahead, refrigerate the cupcakes and let them sit out at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before serving.
